facts.fact: 贝克斯与苏齐都收到米色信封请柬，苏齐判断此事严重蹊跷
facts.anchor: I’ve got a cream envelope as well

facts.fact: 她们用备用钥匙进朱迪思家取信，发现朱迪思没有收到同样的请柬
facts.anchor: there wasn’t a heavy cream envelope with her name and address on it

facts.fact: 苏齐承认菲利波斯是坏人，但底线是朱迪思不该不告而别地离境
facts.anchor: But I draw the line at her leaving the country without telling us where she’s gone.

facts.fact: 贝克斯在《马洛自由报》上发现疑似给她们的信息
facts.anchor: I think this could be the message we’ve been looking for.

facts.fact: 苏齐上门向塔妮卡借手铐
facts.anchor: We need to borrow a set of handcuffs

facts.fact: 苏齐宣布要用塔妮卡的手铐做公民逮捕
facts.anchor: We’re going to make a citizen’s arrest using a pair of your handcuffs

facts.fact: 塔妮卡声明若她们私自对付嫌疑人，她将被迫举报
facts.anchor: If you know who the killer is and try to deal with him on your own, I’ll be forced to report you.

facts.fact: 贝克斯表态当晚赴舞会当面指证哈莱福德勋爵
facts.anchor: We’re going to the ball tonight. We’re going to confront Lord Harleyford.

facts.fact: 塔妮卡最终打电话给布伦丹，报告两人的计划并要求阻止
facts.anchor: I need you to stop them.
